en.description:
Play Xiangqi like never before — right on your Apple Watch.

Experience the classic strategy game of Chinese Chess in a fast, modern, and beautifully designed format built specifically for the wrist. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned player, this version makes it easy to jump in, think fast, and enjoy every move.
Multiple Ways to Play

• Play vs Computer – Challenge a built-in AI anytime
• Local 2 Player – Share your watch and play side-by-side
• Network Play – Battle friends remotely using a simple friend code
• Designed for Apple Watch
• Digital Crown Zoom – Smoothly zoom in and out for precision control
• Drag & Drop Moves – Intuitive piece movement made for a small screen
• Clean, Focused Interface – No clutter, just strategy
Smart Gameplay Features
• Replay Moves – Review key moments and learn from every turn
• Valid Move Enforcement – Only legal moves allowed (no mistakes)
• Check & Checkmate Alerts – Stay informed as the battle unfolds
• Red vs Black Classic Setup – Authentic Xiangqi experience

Play Anytime, Anywhere
Perfect for quick matches on the go or longer strategic battles. Whether you have a minute or an hour, your next game is always just a glance away.
Sharpen your mind, challenge your friends, and carry one of the world’s greatest strategy games on your wrist.

Download now and start your next match.
